title: Anduril and Qualcomm Partner for US-Built Laptop
excerpt: Defense contractor Anduril and chipmaker Qualcomm plan to build a laptop entirely in the United States by 2027.
body_html:
Defense contractor Anduril and chipmaker Qualcomm have announced a partnership to manufacture laptops entirely within the United States. The collaboration is scheduled to begin with a single model set for launch in 2027.

As part of this initiative, the companies have stated a long-term goal to encourage the broader computer industry to establish a completely domestic supply chain. According to the announcement, the initial laptop model will meet Buy American standards at the time of its release.
